title: Test launcher resolves pwsh installed as a Windows app execution alias
outcome: Test launcher resolves pwsh installed as a Windows app execution alias
acceptance: On Windows, scripts/test-launcher.mjs executable() accepts a PATH candidate that is an app execution alias (statSync throws EACCES while lstatSync and accessSync F_OK succeed) and launches it, so a full gate runs when pwsh exists only as %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe.

A launcher test covers the alias case (stat refusal with a present reparse-point entry is resolved; a genuinely missing or non-file candidate is still refused with the existing executable-not-found error) and fails if the alias acceptance is removed.

completion.summary:
Landed 129c5ed on master. scripts/test-launcher.mjs executable() now accepts, on Windows, a PATH candidate whose stat is refused with EACCES while lstat reports a link (the Store app execution alias for pwsh under WindowsApps). It still requires access(F_OK). Every other stat failure is refused as before, and a failed lstat keeps the original refusal as the diagnostic. The lookup's file-system calls and platform are injectable for tests; callers are unchanged.
- The new launcher test covers the alias and each refusal, and failed with the alias branch disabled.
- Live proof: the bootstrap focused pwsh run failed at preflight on master and passed on this tree. Full gate test-4e061dfa passed 12/12 on freeze 456b32c4, with its rust stage running pwsh through the alias.
- Pair: Codex had no findings; Claude had one Low (comment wording, filed as its own item) and one Note.
- Evaluation 656cfa27 passed 2/2.
